correctness.rationale: For every directed cycle on at least three vertices, all-one witnesses force supports into a directed Hamiltonian cycle. The cases of all but one arc and all arcs fail by a two-block forced continuation; for supports missing at least two cycle arcs, reversing the quotient cyclic order of positive path blocks realizes every negative constraint, with the three-block boundary treated explicitly. Inclusion-exclusion over remaining forbidden arcs counts exact labels by factorials. Ordered component cuts count supports. Along an all-positive branch, \(n-2\) positive arcs leave one hypothesis, excluding a depth-\(n-1\) mistake tree. A standalone exhaustive verifier for \(3\le n\le6\) checks the polynomial and all exact label counts; finite checks are not general proofs.

value.rationale: The exact uniform trace law is a nontrivial coefficientwise refinement beyond a dimension bound. The all-n classification of shattered directed arc supports, its factorial polynomial and sharp Littlestone equality provide a natural complete answer for the single-cycle conjugacy class. It distinguishes incidence learnability of oriented cyclic permutations from their unoriented tour quotient by a structural reversal-of-blocks argument.
